title: Operator-facing surface elicited between cli, httpEndpoint and none
asA: operator picking how ad-hoc runs and re-drives are invoked
iWant: the elicited operator surface (cli, httpEndpoint or none) recorded at apply time
soThat: the applying project builds one thin shim against the jobs-runtime contract without the blueprint prescribing a CLI framework or an HTTP router

acceptanceCriteria.description: The blueprint declares an elicited parameter operatorSurface with the three enum values cli, httpEndpoint, none in the ADR contribution set (implicit through ADR-3102 elicits section not shipped as a separate ADR because the operator-surface choice does not conflict on a shipped topic); the guide names all three values and the default posture (none for a fresh scaffold; the applying project promotes to cli or httpEndpoint under its own decision). The blueprint does NOT ship the CLI or the HTTP endpoint itself.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the shipped blueprint files after this train lands
acceptanceCriteria.when: grep queries walk the guide and README
acceptanceCriteria.then: guide/jobs-background.md contains the substring operator-facing surface and names all three values cli, httpEndpoint, none; README.md names the same three values; neither ships a CLI binary nor an HTTP router
